Axiom: Locator vocabulary is fixed: `getByRole`, `getByLabel`, `getByPlaceholder`, `getByText`, `getByTestId`. CSS selectors (`.class`, `#id`), XPath, and `nth-child` chains are forbidden as primary locators — they bind the test to implementation details with no contract status. `getByTestId` is a last-resort fallback for elements with no semantic role, and it is reserved for stable test IDs the component team owns.
